title: Butterfly On the Wing
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Couples don't end the round where the progression puts them.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.

figures.text: mad robins, larks in front this is a (Mad Ricochet) , you walk the path of mad robins , the difference is you ricochet out with both hands with the same gender, the larks start in center the robins go in the larks go in, the robins go in then the larks cross to there neighbors
pass through across the set larks pass left in center
slice left and straight back to new couple
